classes.requiresVerbatim: AT-1-ASSEMBLY (ACTIVE): a generated ACCEPT emission assembles offline install inputs (manifest, tree, archive+archiveDigest, declarations) with no network. AT-1-TRUSTED-INSTALL (INACTIVE until DR-112 / ID-DEP-P3): clean-machine install success from those signed inputs. Until then report blocked-on-ride, not install-success.
Removing PATH, system runtime, and project package-manager state does not change the emission or the clean-install result. An implicit-download attempt is RJ-5 plus typed remediation.

Every non-Windows-deferred DR-103 TC-PATH class member is produced by fixtureGenerator from a valid emission, or is an authored exact-byte fixture the production validator refuses. Production S-3-EMIT does not emit hostile PATH bytes. Windows-only classes remain absent.

The conformance report carries opaque roleSubprotocol/subprotocolVersion tokens AND a closed health applicability record per role/platform (executed-pass|executed-fail|not-applicable|blocked-on-ride). executed-pass and executed-fail require {path, sha256}. not-applicable and blocked-on-ride require the AT-4/ID-DEP-P4 ride. A report with no applicability record is AT-4 fail. Actual negotiation, framing, and hostile dual-channel classes remain DR-102 / DR-G21. This class proves the adapter emitted the tokens, recorded health standing, and did not translate frames.

AT-5-ASSEMBLY (ACTIVE): the emission plus reserved trust slots is complete as bytes for no-network use; missing reserved material is typed unavailability. AT-5-TRUSTED-INSTALL (INACTIVE until DR-112/DR-110): no-network install-success. Until then blocked-on-ride, not silent success.

DECLARED as a class. Vectors are INACTIVE until DR-110 and DR-112 close or dispose. If either closes by scoped disposition, this class follows that disposition's terms (D-002 symmetry). Until then no adapter may emit updateData semantics.

The emission binds {path, sha256} evidence joins for each applicable owner-defined gate among DR-G01..G05 / DR-115 / DR-118 / DR-G13. Threshold VALUES remain those owners. For each applicable gate the report MUST record standing pass | fail | blocked-on-ride. pass requires the owner-defined result to be present, custody-verified, and passing. If the owner has not supplied a gate or disposition, standing is blocked-on-ride, never compliant. A digest-bound failing result is fail, not pass. This class does not invent numbers.
